About

The Agentic Shopping Index tracks, week by week, which online stores AI shopping agents can discover and buy from through open protocols, across Shopify stores, big retailers and other online stores.

It is run by Gus, an experienced enterprise software consultant, as an independent project. It is not affiliated with Google, Shopify, OpenAI, Microsoft, Perplexity, PayPal or any retailer listed.

All figures come from our own public crawl or from linked official sources. Some links may become disclosed affiliate links in future; that will never change a store's result.
